doc.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014

title: Listening: Houston Person with Joey DeFrancesco
summary: A clip of Houston Person's record with Harper's brother on it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you remember the date?
No, I’m not even sure I have that one in my collection.
Yes Houston Person with Joey DeFrancesca.
Yeah. I think it might have been called “Why Not” or it might have been the Young Lions.
The Young Lion and his Cub [The Lion and His Pride]. Yeah I remember. Who was playing guitar?
I can’t remember. But your brother’s on it.
Yeah, yeah. Like I was saying, the sound, you know what I mean?
